answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must lock non-refundable proof-of-work stake burned into a common registry. Each additional identity requires superlinear cryptographic stake scaling quadratically or exponentially, O(n^2), ensuring deep economic friction. Like water eroding limestone across a vast karst topography, an attacker's capital drains into an ocean of forfeited value, making fake ivory credentials mathematically ruinous to spawn at scale.
